result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but there is a content typo in the search placeholder, a hard-clipped restaurant name in the horizontal carousel, and inconsistent styling of the favourite (heart) buttons between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: Search field placeholder reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is misspelled (should be 'Restaurants').
issues.suggestion: Fix the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' and add a spell-check/lint pass over UI copy strings.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card's title is hard-cut at the screen edge ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, and the card image/price are also sliced, so it reads as broken text rather than an intentional peek of the next item.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis to card titles, and set consistent carousel padding/peek width so the partially visible card is clearly a scroll affordance.

issues.description: The favourite heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the Tokumaru Ramen card uses a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favourite button treatment (same background, size, and icon colour) across all cards, using a single component with one active/inactive state style.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is cut off mid-chip at the right edge (a sliver of a pill after 'Healthy'), giving the impression of a clipped element rather than a scrollable row.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding or a fade/gradient mask at the edge of the scrollable chip row so partial chips look intentional.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is truncated by the bottom navigation bar with its title, rating and metadata not visible, and there is no visual separation/shadow indicating content continues under the nav bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view, and consider a subtle elevation/scrim on the nav bar.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favourite buttons, bottom nav icons) rely purely on visuals with no visible label for the bell/hearts, and the red unread dot conveys state by colour alone.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add to favourites') and ensure the unread state is exposed to assistive tech rather than colour only.
